overview_description.description:
Bitmovin is a young and dynamic multimedia company. Their principal expertise is in the domain of information and communication technologies for audio-visual networks, in particular for HTTP streaming services and embedded multimedia applications. Additionally, bitmovin provides consulting and standardization services, specifically towards ISO/IEC MPEG.

Bitmovin multimedia is a spin-of company of the Alpen-Adria-University Klagenfurt, where most of their experts come from, and the ALICANTE EU FP7-ICT project. Together with the University they are still investigated in all kinds of research in the field of multimedia and especially in state of the art standardization at this sector e.g. ISO/IEC MPEG. Their highly skilled and motivated employees work in their offices in the Lakeside Science & Technology Park, Building B01.

Bitmovin offers API-based products to help developers solve the most complex video problems with cloud native software that runs anywhere. The company was founded in 2013 by Stefan Lederer, Christopher Müller and Christian Timmerer.

Bitmovin is based in San Francisco, CA, USA and Klagenfurt, Austria and privately owned. The company's investors include Atomico, Dawn Capital, YCombinator (YC S15), SpeedInvest and Constantia Industries.

about_short_description.short_description: Bitmovin is a multimedia technology company providing adaptive streaming video infrastructure for global digital media companies.

product.name: Bitmovin Player
product.description: A cross-platform video playback solution for live and on-demand streaming, with adaptive bitrate, DRM, advertising, subtitles, offline playback, and low-latency support.

product.name: Bitmovin VOD Encoder
product.description: A cloud-based video-on-demand encoding service that converts source media into adaptive streaming formats while optimizing quality, processing speed, codec support, storage, and bandwidth usage.

product.name: Bitmovin Live Encoder
product.description: A cloud-based live video encoding service for events and continuous channels, supporting resilient, scalable delivery with low-latency workflows, monetization, and live-to-VOD processing.

product.name: Bitmovin Observability
product.description: A video playback monitoring and analytics platform that analyzes viewer sessions, playback quality, errors, performance, and advertising behavior to support QoS and QoE optimization.

product.name: Bitmovin AI Scene Analysis
product.description: An AI-based video analysis service that generates scene-level metadata for contextual advertising, ad scheduling, highlight creation, content organization, and other automated video workflows.

product.name: Bitmovin Stream Lab
product.description: An automated video stream testing service that validates playback and quality on real devices, browsers, Smart TVs, consoles, and mobile platforms, including clear and DRM-protected streams.
